_note: URI Office M2 (owner request 2026-10-12): a new workbook built from one or more source .xlsx files. Baseline is the M1 commit it branched from (phase/uri-office 6348b1b1, M1 with the M1-c2 repairs), so the review covers the M2 diff only; M1 is reviewed separately. Run in a Linux cloud clone of github.com/sche004-cyber/Uri with a fresh claude_cli reviewer at the exact candidate commit; Windows PC results are gate evidence (docs/office/M2_PLAN_AND_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA.md section 8), not the review. Integration is none.
review_focus: M2-AC1..AC3 sources: uri_office/sources.py and Office.open_new/add_sources reuse the M1 path rule (grants.grant_open), copy in, refuse a file changing during copy, all or nothing, at most 10, never write a source, never show a path; grants released on close and after the new file is created
M2-AC4 untrusted data: source excerpts reach the Brain only inside data blocks (uri_office/brain.py SYSTEM_NEW, build_body)

M2-AC5/AC6 ops: ops.copy_edits (values only, caps, unknown source/sheet/range refused, text starting with '=' never copied as a formula); add_sheet/rename_sheet only for engine new (Draft._sheet_op); copy_range and sheet ops refused for existing files
M2-AC7 decide_all (Draft.decide_all, proposed_set_sha256; Dart OfficeController.proposedSetSha256 must match the Python hash): bound to draft version and set hash, all or nothing

M2-AC9/AC10 new file: approval card summary (decision M2-D1, owner may overrule) still binds the full content; uri_office/xlsx_new.py never replaces an existing file (temporary file + no-overwrite link or O_EXCL), the session becomes an ordinary local M1 session
M2-AC8 pane: sources, Add file, Accept all / Reject all, at most 50 cards, Save as new file only (uri_ui/lib/living/office/office_panel.dart, office_controller.dart)
M1 behaviour unchanged for existing files and Google (M2-AC11)
_test_setup_note: Owner approval 2026-10-11: fresh test worktrees (regression proof, qualify, baseline) install the page's npm dependencies first; without them the real-engine tests in tests/office/test_page.py skip and no repair can show fail-before (run 1, P2-P4). The driver change (scripts/dev_workflow/lifecycle.py test_setup) is tooling, not part of the office milestone.
